verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own marketing says users can access team benefits, including healthcare, and manage everything from the payroll account. It also documents setting up and calculating deductions from each paycheck. However, the asterisked healthcare claim suggests it may be an add-on or partner offering, and nothing describes the enrollment workflow or confirms that benefit deductions sync automatically into payroll. Missing for 10: documented health-plan enrollment and administration workflow, explicit automatic sync of premium deductions to payroll, clarity on first-party vs partner-provided coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
